{{Quote|Lieutenant TK-575 reporting. All useful cargo has been confiscated and added to our stores. The smuggler has been judged and sentenced."|TK-575|<ref name="F&D CR" />}}
'''TK-575''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He once captured an [[Unidentified smuggler (Stormtrooper Officer Report)|smuggler]] and confiscated his cargo.<ref name="F&D CR" />
